headline: EU Agriculture Chief Leads Delegation to Mexico with $5.5B Investment Strategy
summary: A 120-member European delegation representing 22 nations arrived in Mexico pursuing investment opportunities across agri-food, energy, transportation, pharmaceuticals, and healthcare under a $5.5 billion strategy.
why: Cross-regional investment delegations foster bilateral trade agreements and foreign direct investment in emerging industrial markets.

impacts.name: Mexico
impacts.why: European investment delegations stimulate capital inflows across multiple domestic sectors.
